title: APB slave: data0 upper-16b truncation + RO-register PSLVERR omission
source: VeriSight projects/apb. Ground truth from apb_slave.sv:79-92 intentional defects + apb_spec.md.

ground_truth.notes: Two independent RTL defects. (1) apb_slave.sv:92 writes reg_data0 <= {16'h0, pwdata[15:0]}, dropping pwdata[31:16] -> read of 0x08 returns 0x0000beef instead of 0xdeadbeef. (2) apb_slave.sv:83 write to RO STATUS reg keeps pslverr<=0 instead of asserting it. Either is an acceptable primary root cause; the first-causal log error is the data0 truncation at 650000 ns.
